direction.camera: Guide attention with brutalist scale; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: let one oversized unpolished headline carry the frame; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with raw type; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with graphic weight.
direction.lighting: hard flat contrast; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: raw paper and dense black pigment; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around forceful cut; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use brutalist scale,raw type,hard margin,bare structure,forceful cut,graphic weight as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
